summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its monthly operating statistics for September 2026. The Irish carrier reported 20.1 million guests, up 4% from 19.4 million a year earlier, with load factor steady at 94% across over 111,700 flights; rolling twelve-month traffic rose 5% to 215.1 million guests. Management noted over 1,000 cancellations tied to a UK ATC system collapse, Belgian ATC strikes, and Mount Etna eruptions. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer traffic update furnished to the SEC; it contains no transaction, ownership, board, or capital-structure event. Nothing here triggers special-situations or risk-arb analysis; only operational and capacity trends are relevant.
